task.text: If the 20 bit physical address of the 12 location inside code segment is 7ACDBH,what will be the content of the CS register and what is the 20 bit physical address of code segment start

attempts.high: I'm putting together a worksheet on x86 real-mode segmentation and I need an original problem in the style of "given a 20-bit physical address inside a code segment, find the CS register value and the segment start address." Make up your own setup — pick whatever offset and physical address you like, design the scenario however you think teaches the concept best, then work through the full solution. Your call on the framing, just keep it around the difficulty of a basic CS/offset computation.
attempts.low: If the 20 bit physical address of the location at offset 12 inside the code segment is 7ACDBH, compute the content of the CS register and the 20 bit physical address where the code segment starts. Show the standard steps: subtract the offset to get the base, then derive CS by dividing by 16. Just apply the usual segmentation formula, no alternative methods.
